Part.name: Nizh / Nozh ERA cassette
Part.description: Placeable reactive armour. One module reacts once against eligible HEAT or APFSDS hits. Up to 48% less remaining HEAT penetration and 12% less APFSDS penetration. About 31.4 kg. Compact bolt mounts; follows vehicle paint and camouflage. Rotate the closed protective face outward; freely move, mirror and duplicate. Return to Edit to restore. Gameplay calibration; no tandem simulation. Spent mount, passive collision and mass remain.
